name: Pagination / Search Results
description: Search Results product scenario for the Pagination component.

controls.name: page
controls.description: Controlled positive integer page; displayed within the current total/pageSize bounds.

controls.name: defaultPage
controls.description: Initial uncontrolled page (1-indexed); later changes are ignored.

controls.name: total
controls.description: Total item count: a nonnegative safe integer. Defaults to 0, displaying page 1.

controls.name: pageSize
controls.description: Items per page: a positive safe integer. Defaults to 10.

controls.name: siblingCount
controls.description: Neighbor count, an integer from 0 to 20. Edge ranges fill the available slots. Defaults to 1.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disable page changes and picker opening; an already open picker can still be closed.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Membrane spacing around the outer navigation buttons; the dialog owns its own spacing.

controls.name: surfaceTitle
controls.description: Page-picker dialog title at any viewport size. Defaults to labels.choosePage.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Internal control labels. The nav itself uses native aria-label or aria-labelledby.
